title: Benefit Credit Entitlements Granted on Each Northbeam Circle Membership Year
content:
| Figure | Circle Free Membership | Circle Plus Annual | Circle Total Annual | Circle Total Household Annual | Circle Business Pro | Circle Business Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Anniversary reward credit (USD) | 0.00 | 10.00 | 40.00 | 50.00 | 75.00 | 300.00 |
| Installation credit (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 900.00 |
| Delivery credit (USD) | 0.00 | 15.00 | 60.00 | 80.00 | 120.00 | 400.00 |
| Service credit (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 | 200.00 | 750.00 |
| Credit life (days from grant) | 0 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 400 | 400 |
| Benefit redemptions allowed per year | 0 | 4 | 12 | 16 | 40 | 120 |

## The named credits of a Northbeam Circle Membership

The anniversary reward credit is the benefit credit granted on each membership anniversary. The
installation credit goes toward installation labour, the delivery credit toward delivery charges and the
service credit toward bench and on-site repair labour; each is granted for a membership year. The credit
life is the days a granted benefit credit stays spendable from the grant date. The yearly redemption
allowance is the most benefit redemptions allowed in one membership year.

How several credits combine on one charge is recorded per tier as the stacking basis:

| Tier | Stacking basis on one charge |
|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | not applicable |
| Circle Plus Annual | one credit per charge |
| Circle Total Annual | one credit per charge |
| Circle Total Household Annual | one credit per charge |
| Circle Business Pro | additive up to the charge |
| Circle Business Elite | additive up to the charge |

## Notes to the schedule

Circle Free Membership carries no benefit credit of any kind: all four credit figures stand at 0.00, the
credit life at 0 days and the yearly redemption allowance at 0. Circle Plus Annual carries the
anniversary reward of 10.00 and the delivery credit of 15.00 but no installation or service credit.
Installation and service credits begin at Circle Total Annual, at 100.00 and 50.00.

Taken together, the four credits granted in one membership year come to 0.00 on Circle Free Membership,
25.00 on Circle Plus Annual, 250.00 on Circle Total Annual, 340.00 on Circle Total Household Annual,
645.00 on Circle Business Pro and 2350.00 on Circle Business Elite. The credit life is 365 days on the
consumer tiers that carry credit and 400 days on both business tiers.
